# PokemonBuilder

> PokemonBuilder (pokemonbuilder.app) is a free Pokémon team builder for competitive play — VGC doubles and Smogon singles — in the browser, in English and Portuguese. It analyses a team while you build it (type coverage, shared weaknesses, threats from the current meta), and has a full Pokédex, a damage calculator, speed tiers, usage statistics and real tournament teams that import into the builder in one click. Made by Enzo Esmeraldo.

Everything is free and works on a phone or a computer, with nothing to install; teams can be saved without an account. Every page exists in English at the root and in Portuguese under `/pt` (for example https://pokemonbuilder.app/pt/builder).

Data sources: ladder usage from Smogon's monthly statistics of Pokémon Showdown battles, merged with Limitless tournament results for VGC regulations; tournament teams from the community-maintained VGCPastes repository; Pokémon, moves, abilities and items from PokéAPI and Pokémon Showdown. The datasets are refreshed every day.

What it does not do: it does not connect to a game console, it has no battle ladder, and it does not import pasted Showdown teams yet. Teams export in Pokémon Showdown's text format.

## Tools

- [Pokémon Team Builder](https://pokemonbuilder.app/builder): build a team of six and see type coverage, shared weaknesses and resistances, meta threats, partner suggestions from tournament teams and Smogon sets; export to Showdown, share by link or image.
- [Pokémon Damage Calculator](https://pokemonbuilder.app/damage-calculator): damage rolls and KO chances between any two Pokémon in VGC and Smogon formats, with items, abilities, natures, EVs and Tera.
- [Pokémon Speed Tiers](https://pokemonbuilder.app/speed-tiers): the level 50 Speed of every Pokémon with no EVs, 252 EVs, a +Speed nature or a Choice Scarf.
- [Pokémon Meta & Usage Stats](https://pokemonbuilder.app/meta): usage by format and rating band, with each Pokémon's top items, abilities, moves, spreads and teammates.
- [Best Pokémon VGC Teams](https://pokemonbuilder.app/best-teams): the top tournament finishes of the current regulation, the Pokémon those teams use most and the pairs that keep coming back.
- [Pokémon VGC Tournament Teams](https://pokemonbuilder.app/tournaments): real tournament teams with player, placing and full sets.

## Reference

- [Pokédex](https://pokemonbuilder.app/pokedex): every Pokémon; each page (e.g. https://pokemonbuilder.app/pokemon/garchomp) has types, weaknesses, base stats, the most used competitive build and its tournament teams.
- [Pokémon Type Chart](https://pokemonbuilder.app/types): weaknesses, resistances and immunities of the 18 types, with a page per type.
- [Pokémon Move List](https://pokemonbuilder.app/moves), [Abilities List](https://pokemonbuilder.app/abilities) and [Items List](https://pokemonbuilder.app/items): what each one does in battle.
- [Gym Leaders](https://pokemonbuilder.app/gyms): every gym leader and their team, game by game.

## About the site

- [About](https://pokemonbuilder.app/about): who makes PokemonBuilder, where its data comes from and how to get in touch (pokemonteambuilderadmin@gmail.com).
- [How the team analysis works](https://pokemonbuilder.app/methodology): the weakness rules, the team score formula, how meta threats are ranked, and how the damage calculator and speed tiers compute their numbers.
- [Privacy policy](https://pokemonbuilder.app/privacy) and [Terms of use](https://pokemonbuilder.app/terms).

## Optional

- [PokéPuzzle](https://pokemonbuilder.app/pokepuzzle): a daily Pokémon guessing game.
- [Champion Challenge](https://pokemonbuilder.app/challenge): a daily DS-style battle against Cynthia.
- [Pokémon Quiz](https://pokemonbuilder.app/quiz): name every Pokémon of a generation or of an official trait.
- [Community](https://pokemonbuilder.app/feed): teams and posts shared by players.
- [Sitemap](https://pokemonbuilder.app/sitemap.xml)
